summary: Public v2 auto-polls to terminal, exposes succeeded sourceRevision for export, and scopes opaque resume checkpoints to the authenticated principal.
invariants: Succeeded operation status exposes sourceRevision from the owner-scoped durable result.
Polling is single-flight, visibility-aware, bounded, and stops at a terminal status.
An uncertain admission reuses its key only for an exact request fingerprint or requires explicit abandon.
Browser checkpoints contain no request content or download grants and rotate on principal scope change.
The dashboard entry remains gated by PUBLIC_V2_WEB_CANARY_ENABLED.
forbidden: Do not expose editable-hybrid in the public v2 browser flow.
Do not replace or silently cut over the v1 generation flow without the canary flag.
